name: Kimono Princess
source:
Even though you said you'd never go, now you're at a summer festival...That's where you have a fateful encounter with the Kimono Princess.

Play through many different endings as you learn more about the mysterious Kimono Princess.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316093826/http://pikasite.mew151.net/product.php?id=5]The Subject[/url]]
translation:
虽然你说过永远不会去，但现在你正在参加夏日祭典……那就是你与和服公主命运般的相遇的地方。

当你更多地了解神秘的和服公主时，请尝试许多不同的结局。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316093826/http://pikasite.mew151.net/product.php?id=5]主题[/url]]
